page.overview:
Who is Vildar Blin?

Vildar Blin was a Human male corporal and scout of the Alliance Special Forces during the Galactic Civil War. After his brother betrayed their family by joining the Galactic Empire's Commission for the Preservation of the New Order, Blin joined the Bormea sector's Rebel underground, and he later served with Alliance High Command at its Echo Base headquarters on the ice planet Hoth. Blin was killed during the Battle of Hoth in 3 ABY while storming a downed All Terrain Armored Transport that exploded as a result of friendly Rebel snowspeeder fire.

Vildar Blin was once a member of the local security force on the planet Corulag, However, Blin joined the sector's Rebel underground ice planet Hoth, where he served with Alliance Special Forces as a corporal.

During the Battle of Hoth in 3 ABY, Blin fought in the defensive trenches surrounding Echo Base, Trained in reconnaissance, Blin helped spot for the Rebels' artillery and marked for capture any salvageable Imperial equipment from fallen All Terrain Armored Transports.

In the skies above the trenches, Rogue Group pilot Wedge Antilles downed one of the AT-ATs by ensnaring its legs with high-tension cable from his T-47 airspeeder, or "snowspeeder," tripping it to the ground, the first Imperial walker neutralized during the battle. Blin and an assistant boisterously stormed out of the trenches at Firest's behest for the grounded AT-AT. They reached the walker before any Imperials could emerge and were about to enter the AT-AT when a snowspeeder pilot fired upon the vulnerable walker, destroying it. Large chunks of shrapnel flung the Rebel soldiers backward, and Blin and his assistant were killed in the explosion.
